name: zcode-dispatch
description: Bidirectional dispatch between ZCode desktop and DSH / Grok Bot ([Project: X] routing, persistent session<->job mapping, automatic result reporting: direct HTTP by default, Yobiru optional).

description_i18n.en: Bidirectional dispatch between ZCode desktop and DSH / Grok Bot ([Project: X] routing, persistent session<->job mapping, automatic result reporting: direct HTTP by default, Yobiru optional).
